evidence_type: offline local PE/Capstone, NOT live REA evidence

interpretation.count: 3; if current < third then 2; if current < 2*third then decrement once
interpretation.creation: For each enabled overlay1..3, create its numeric ID and ID+1, mode 3
interpretation.increase: When count > previous, remfunc5 clears all pairs, then recreate enabled pairs
interpretation.decrease: Remove higher disabled pairs, preserve surviving lower animation objects
interpretation.retail_lowest_group_quirk: At 0x6fb4c7fb compares first overlay numeric ID, not count, against 1; positive pool always retains at least group one
interpretation.remove: For all three configured IDs and ID+1, remove the 1ofN range returned by D2Common#10680

limits: Static behavior only, no original gameplay or GPU frames captured
Retail 1ofN=1 overlays are the supported reconstruction scope
Riiablo treats zero/missing pool as no visual; exhausted authoritative armor removes the state
